discoveryOnly: The Joe full-source survey reveals additional maximum-damage and resource permutations; these are available material, not evidence of scarcity.
Most of the 2023 companion guide is unprocessed; only three corroborated jump-response demonstrations are added.
interpretationDecisions: Raw Drive Rush costs one bar, a cancel costs three, and each OD special costs two; prerequisite knockdown resources are stated separately.
Printed +31/+35/+36/+42/+47 advantage labels are source results, not added wait commands.
Timing normals marked whiff are not combo hits. Blocked pressure, throw baits, trades and reversal responses use separate conditions.
The seven corner Phalanx setups require the recorded light623LP juggle knockdown and spacing; the caption generic623P is not a claim for every strength.
Safe-jump demonstrations show forward jump9 and jumping HP whiffing before landing guard against the recorded Ryu OD reversal only.
The Scutum throws shown use normal214LK; a brief gold normal-stance flash does not establish OD spend.

Enfold versus Ryu evades the recorded OD with throw-recovery posture; Juri/Cammy/Guile examples absorb100/300/300 damage through armor; Ed requires later guard. Other opponents listed only in captions are not claimed as demonstrated.
Full-resolution neutral+heldHP input histories distinguish standing-heavy juggle enders from the visually crouched holding animation.
The companion source has no visible input history. Narration plus the performed animation corroborates light-kick Scutum, crouching HP, and the jumping-MP target; the jump direction is unspecified.

preparedReview.method: All 71 prepared grids and actual first/last decoded frames visually inspected. Affected loops and moments were regenerated and rechecked after boundary and annotation corrections. Native originals support strengths, held inputs, timing whiffs, guard/armor outcomes and source transitions. Independent review is recorded separately.

Select the actual whiffed jab at1243.95, then show crouch guard at1244.20 and the later guard at1245.0. Remove the false opening-miss ordering.
